posts.body:
Hi, I am a bit confused how vehicle fishing works for you but not land fishing
The basics are to set up your fish via the "Fish" parameter, set up your key/gamepad/touch ui buttons via the Fish Key, Fish Gamepad, etc. parameters, and then set the Fish Enable Switch and turn it ON in game. However, it sounds like you have already done all of this since you seem to be able to fish from vehicles, just not on foot?
There's not much separate you need to do for land fishing, you should be able to walk up to any water tiles, press your configured button on the gamepad/keyboard, and start catching your fish you have set up. If you are not able to do this, could you try it in a fresh project with only [CGMZ] plugins enabled and see if it works there to rule out any plugin conflict?
If the issue is instead that you can start the fishing process but are not catching fish you think you should be catching on land, make sure your fish are set up correctly. The region parameter to determine where fish are caught goes by the tile the player is standing in, not the water tile in front of the player. You also need to set your fish to include a "none" option for vehicles so the player can catch them while not in a vehicle.
